## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link the issue and affected workflow step; distinguish implemented behavior from proposals.

## Validation

List meaningful checks actually run, their outcomes, and material limitations. For repository changes, run `python3 scripts/check_repository.py`.

## Review

- [ ] Scope, command examples, implemented status, and relevant decisions agree.
- [ ] Examples and fixtures are synthetic and contain no private identities or credentials.
- [ ] Added source/assets are original or have documented provenance, permissions, and notices.
- [ ] Changes to authorization, privacy, publication, cost, or data migration are explained where applicable.
